score_meanings.urbanization_pressure_score: Frozen model-derived relative score; NOT a calibrated probability
score_meanings.development_suitability_score: Continuous expert-AHP GIS-MCDA using road proximity, local road density and slope
score_meanings.development_conflict_index_0_1: Pressure * (1 - suitability), only in pressure-model domain
score_meanings.frozen_conservation_priority_0_1: Frozen Section04 conservation priority (CCI); already includes pressure

hotspot_screening.rank_cutoff: Top 10% within each index's valid domain
hotspot_screening.geojson_contains: Only the 58 baseline candidate hotspots; CSV retains all 673 screened groups

limitations: Missing scores are unknown/unavailable, never zero.
GN boundaries leave 2.133336 square kilometres unattributed.
Dominant GN name is for display; original GN summaries use fractional polygon intersection.
DCI and conservation priority are separate; do not add or multiply them together.
Hotspots are exploratory, parameter-sensitive clusters, not statistically significant hotspots.
Review classes are not official zoning rules or development permissions.
Historical green-to-built detections do not prove illegal development.
Drainage, flood hazard, infrastructure, legal restrictions and field checks are not resolved by these outputs.
